name: Overwhelming Odds
description: Counts allies against enemies within %radius% tiles. Outnumbering them deals %diff_dmg% damage to every enemy in the area for each unit of the advantage.
details: Being outnumbered instead heals every ally in the area %diff_heal% for each unit of the deficit.

upgrade.summary: Gains a passive: every attack this unit makes scales with who has the numbers, board-wide.
details: Being outnumbered instead heals every ally in the area %diff_heal% for each unit of the deficit.
The passive counts the whole board, not the area: with more allies alive than enemies, each of this unit's attacks deals %passive_damage% more damage per unit of the advantage.
Outnumbered, each of its attacks instead heals it %passive_heal% per unit of the deficit, without hitting any harder.
Both apply to this unit alone, and both fire on a Counterstrike - untouched by its damage reduction.
